motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disable animations and transitions under reduced-motion preference.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Static CSS specimen of the installed Notra variant; React busy behavior remains in the source component.
components.css: .ds-button{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;font-size:14px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:32px;padding:0 10px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms ease,filter 140ms ease;color:var(--primary-foreground,#fff);background:linear-gradient(to bottom,color-mix(in oklab,var(--primary,#242424),black 8%),color-mix(in oklab,var(--primary,#242424),black 20%));border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--primary,#242424) 60%,transparent);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.28),0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.18);}.ds-button:hover{filter:brightness(1.1)}.ds-ghost:hover{filter:none;background:var(--muted-surface,#f5f5f5)}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#767676);outline-offset:3px;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--ring,#777) 50%,transparent)}.ds-button:active{translate:0 1px}.ds-button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed;pointer-events:none}@supports(corner-shape:squircle){.ds-button:not(.ds-ghost){corner-shape:squircle;border-radius:12px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
A compact monochrome workspace follows the user-selected dplprint.glynn.cc reference: a solid navigation rail, thin toolbar, plain headings and functional content. System typography and neutral surfaces keep attention on text and camera work.

The implementation imports actual installed Notra registry buttons, select, sidebar, InstrumentModule cards and toasts directly. Their supplied material treatments remain intact; Base UI-backed progress and alerts share the registry foundation. The reference is directional, not a claim of pixel equivalence.
keyCharacteristics: Compact shell and restrained monochrome surfaces.
Direct registry controls with their supplied states.
Full-screen sentence focus with a subordinate camera preview.
dos: Do import the installed Notra components from their source paths.
Do use real loading, disabled, error and selected states.
Do preserve keyboard focus visibility and reduced-motion behavior.
Do show camera and microphone state in plain text.
donts: Don't replace registry components with lookalike adapters.
Don't introduce decorative dashboard cards, invented charts or performance claims.
Don't add blue accents, decorative gradients, glass shells or ornamental headings.
Don't treat the supplied registry depth effects as permission to decorate the surrounding shell.
